subject: Converting Dovetail to Marketplace billing — migration & co-sell activation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@dovetail.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Converting Dovetail to Marketplace billing — migration & co-sell activation

Samira —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our renewal conversation, here’s a short plan for converting Dovetail to AWS Marketplace billing and kicking off the co-sell enablement with your account team. I captured assumptions and the minimal docs we need to close the loop.

High-level timeline (target):
- Week 1 (this week): sign amendment to move invoicing to AWS Marketplace and confirm SOW values in HUBSpot.
- Week 2: finalize AWS entitlements (SKU mapping) and enable consolidated billing with your procurement team.
- Week 3: co-sell enablement kickoff (prep deck + account mapping) with AWS rep.

Action items for Dovetail:
1) Signed amendment (I attached the MAP pdf).
2) Procurement contact and PO cadence (monthly vs. annual).
3) Confirm whether Dovetail wants Redwood to be SellerOfRecord or to use reseller flow (we recommend SellerOfRecord for fastest cutover).

I’m looping in Grace to own the entitlement mapping and Karthik to coordinate the billing amendment. If you can confirm procurement@dovetail.ai as the billing contact I’ll get the DocuSign started.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that makes it easier.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments:
- Dovetail_Marketplace_Migration_MAP.pdf (proposal + SKU mapping)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@dovetail.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@dovetail.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Converting Dovetail to Marketplace billing — migration & co-sell activation

Ben —

Thanks for this and the clear timeline. A few quick questions from procurement before we sign: 
1) We need an explicit statement in the amendment that historic invoices (prior to the marketplace conversion) remain paid under our existing contract; the marketplace billing starts on the amendment effective date.
2) Which SKU will map to our Support add-on? The PDF had two SKUs and procurement wants the exact SKU string for their internal system.
3) Our finance team requires a sample invoice (mock) showing Marketplace invoice fields (PO number, AWS invoice id, and Redwood SOW reference). Can you provide a redacted sample?

I can confirm procurement@dovetail.ai is the correct contact. If possible, can we get DocuSign by EOD Wednesday? Our renewal window closes on Dec 15.

Samira
VP, Finance & Ops | Dovetail AI
samira.khan@dovetail.ai | +1 206-555-0147

> 1) historic invoices remain under existing contract; marketplace starts on amendment effective date.

Quick notes:

I’ll reply to Samira once we have the drafts. Thanks all.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Converting Dovetail to Marketplace billing — migration & co-sell activation

Ben / team —

I confirmed the SKU mapping with Product Licensing: Support add-on will map to SKU RDW-SUPPORT-2026. I've attached a one-page CSV-friendly mapping and a note explaining how to upload to AWS entitlement tooling.

For the amendment language: I recommend the clause read:
"Marketplace billing shall become effective on the amendment's effective date. Charges incurred prior to that effective date remain subject to the pre-existing agreement between the parties."

I'll attach the CSV (Dovetail_SKU_Mapping.csv) and the short guidance doc. Karthik — ping me if you need any additional fields for the mock invoice.

—Grace

grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Ben / Grace / Lauren —

Attached is a redacted sample marketplace invoice showing the PO number field, an example AWS Invoice ID, and the Redwood SOW reference populated. I used the Dovetail SOW id: DV-2026-77 for the example.

I also drafted the short amendment paragraph to include in the DocuSign envelope. Copy below: 

"Effective Date and Prior Charges: The parties agree that charges accrued prior to the Effective Date of this Amendment remain subject to the parties' pre-existing agreement. From the Effective Date onwards, Customer shall be billed via the AWS Marketplace in accordance with the SKU mapping attached as Exhibit A.

Mock invoice filename: Dovetail_Marketplace_Invoice_Sample_redacted.pdf"

Lauren — once Ben confirms we should send to DocuSign I'll upload these attachments.

—Karthik

Thanks — attached are the artifacts you requested: the SKU mapping CSV, the redacted sample invoice, and the proposed amendment language. We recommend SellerOfRecord flow to minimize procurement friction; I'll note that in the DocuSign envelope.

1) Procurement review & sign amendment (we'll push DocuSign link today).
